messages:
taylor: Hey folks, leaving a WindowMount dual monitor arm (VESA) + a gray anti-fatigue standing mat at SF reception tomorrow — free. Fits 27in each, very solid. photo: https://imgur.com/placeholder

sam: Interested in the arm if it's solid. dimensions? weight limit?

taylor: @sam says 8kg per arm, tilt/swivel, comes with screws. no major scratches. I'll tape a note to the box "taylor - free".

nina: I'll take the mat if no one claims it. can pick up after 3pm.

ryan: @taylor can you hold the arm till 2:30? I'm on a lunch meeting but can swing by.

office-bot: Heads up: Lost & Found cleanout is Friday. Items left unclaimed will be donated unless labeled. :broom:

taylor: @ryan yep holding till 2:30. if ryan no-show by 3pm i'll leave for first-come.

sam: Sweet. I'll DM to confirm. Thanks!

taylor: Also have a spare pair of Muni tickets (weekday night) if anyone wants them, free to first reply. no shipping, transfer only.

nina: omg yes for the muni tix pls DM me

ryan: grabbing arm in 15, thanks @taylor :thumbsup:
